scripts.speaker: Father Mareusis
scripts.text:
Ah, I sense you have endured
a past life experience. You must have learned many things before entering Valhalla.

scripts.speaker: Father Mareusis
scripts.text: Unfortunately, I don't think you're ready to become an Acolyte yet. Please finish learning all of the Basic Skills first.

scripts.speaker: Father Mareusis
scripts.text:
In the meantime,
I will wait until
you are ready.
May God be
with you.

scripts.speaker: Father Mareusis
scripts.text:
Well, I welcome you
back from Valhalla and
wish you luck on your
new life's journey.

scripts.speaker: Father Mareusis
scripts.text: Now, venture forth and seek those who need your help. May God light your path.

scripts.speaker: Father Mareusis
scripts.text: Now, venture forth to seek people who need your help. May God enlighten your way.

scripts.speaker: Father Mareusis
scripts.text: I sense that you have endured a past life experience. You must have learned many things before entering Valhalla.

scripts.speaker: Father Mareusis
scripts.text: However, I can tell that you are not suited to be an Acolyte. Please remember who you were in your past life and find your path.

scripts.speaker: Father Mareusis
scripts.text: What is it that you seek?
Change your job to acolyte.
Ask the requirements to be an acolyte.
Quit it.

scripts.speaker: Father Mareusis
scripts.text: Are you feeling okay today? I can tell by your attire that you are already an Acolyte. You're not joking around, are you?

scripts.speaker: Father Mareusis
scripts.text: I'm sorry but it seems you already have your own job, aren't you?

scripts.speaker: Father Mareusis
scripts.text:
Do you truly wish to become a servant of God?
Let's see whether you are ready for it or not... Hmm...

scripts.speaker: Father Mareusis
scripts.text: Oh my?! You haven't accomplished the basic practice yet?! You have a long way to go! Come again after increasing your job level!

scripts.speaker: Father Mareusis
scripts.text:
Hmm... your job level is enough...
Good. Now I will give you the qualification to become an Acolyte.

scripts.speaker: Father Mareusis
scripts.text: Always remember to be thankful to God, who takes care of us all the time. In chaos and times of difficulty, face your hardships with unwavering faith.

scripts.speaker: Father Mareusis
scripts.text: Lastly, I want to sincerely congratulate you on persevering through your trial of penance.

scripts.speaker: Father Mareusis
scripts.text:
Do you wish to become an Acolyte?
Then, you must fulfill the following requirements thinking those are the practices given by God.

scripts.speaker: Father Mareusis
scripts.text:
First, you have to reach at least Novice Job Level 9 and learn all of the Basic Skills.
This is the most basic thing to do, so you need to regard it as the way of training yourself.

scripts.speaker: Father Mareusis
scripts.text: When you think you fulfilled this requirement, then come back to me again. Then you will have a holy job in which you can spread God's will.

scripts.speaker: Father Rubalkabara
scripts.text: Please take care. They should know that you've met me by the time you arrive at the Prontera Sanctuary.

scripts.speaker: Father Rubalkabara
scripts.text: Oh...? You must be the one who aspires to become an Acolyte. I've already received news from the Sanctuary that you might be coming.

scripts.speaker: Father Rubalkabara
scripts.text:
Oh...
Are you one of the
Acolyte applicants...?
Let's see...

scripts.speaker: Father Rubalkabara
scripts.text: Huh? What brings you here? This is a very dangerous place for a Novice like yourself!

scripts.speaker: Father Rubalkabara
scripts.text: Greetings.

scripts.speaker: Father Rubalkabara
scripts.text:
Oh ho...
Have you come into the Deep here for training? Or are you just a Wanderer?

scripts.speaker: Father Rubalkabara
scripts.text: I've sent a carrier pigeon with a message. I hope it will arrive there safely...

scripts.speaker: Father Rubalkabara
scripts.text: Now, your name was {0}, right? Excellent, thank you for visiting me.

scripts.speaker: Father Rubalkabara
scripts.text: I believe you've been told much about Acolytes from Friar Mareusis. Plus, there's plenty of helpful people in the Prontera Sanctuary.

scripts.speaker: Father Rubalkabara
scripts.text: I guess there's really no need for me to teach you much. Besides, I'm sure your someone from your generation may have trouble listening to an old man like me. Hahaha~

scripts.speaker: Father Rubalkabara
scripts.text: Still, lessons may come from the places you'd least expect. God loves to teach his children in strange ways. You'll see.

scripts.speaker: Father Rubalkabara
scripts.text: Well, I'll send the message telling them that you've come to visit me. So, you may now return to the Prontera Sanctuary.

scripts.speaker: Father Rubalkabara
scripts.text: Farewell.

scripts.speaker: Father Rubalkabara
scripts.text:
Your name is {0}?
I don't think your name
is on my list. Hmmm...

scripts.speaker: Father Rubalkabara
scripts.text: Why don't you go back to the Prontera Sanctuary and check again?

scripts.speaker: Father Rubalkabara
scripts.text: Welcome to the Deep. Feel free to sit and contemplate God's message with me. This place is beautiful, even if danger accompanies its sense of serenity...

scripts.speaker: Father Rubalkabara
scripts.text: Whoever you are, please take care of yourself. The monsters in here are shockingly strong, contrary to their cute appearance.

scripts.speaker: Mother Mathilda
scripts.text: I will send a carrier pigeon to the Prontera Sanctuary. When you return, the Priest there should already have received my message.

scripts.speaker: Mother Mathilda
scripts.text: Ah, you must be one of the Acolyte applicants. I sincerely welcome you.

scripts.speaker: Mother Mathilda
scripts.text:
Ah...!
You must be one
of the Acolyte applicants.
I sincerely welcome you.

scripts.speaker: Mother Mathilda
scripts.text: Hello there~

scripts.speaker: Mother Mathilda
scripts.text:
May God
be with you...

scripts.speaker: Mother Mathilda
scripts.text: I will pray to God, and hope that you become an Acolyte soon.

scripts.speaker: Mother Mathilda
scripts.text: What is your name? {0}? Let's see... Ah, you're on my list.

scripts.speaker: Mother Mathilda
scripts.text: I will send a message to the Sanctuary confirming that you, {0} visited me and completed your penance.

scripts.speaker: Mother Mathilda
scripts.text: Please return to the Prontera Sanctuary and speak to the Priest in charge.

scripts.speaker: Mother Mathilda
scripts.text:
Now, what is your name?
{0}? Let's see...

scripts.speaker: Mother Mathilda
scripts.text:
Hmm...
It seems your name
is not on my list...

scripts.speaker: Mother Mathilda
scripts.text: Perhaps you should return to the Prontera Sanctuary and check the destination for your penance trial once again.

scripts.speaker: Mother Mathilda
scripts.text: How is your practice coming along? I certainly hope you're enjoying living in the grace of God.

scripts.speaker: Father Yosuke
scripts.text: What?

scripts.speaker: Father Yosuke
scripts.text:
Hey.
Whatever you are,
you look like an
Acolyte applicant.
Right?

scripts.speaker: Father Yosuke
scripts.text:
Hey.
You look like an Acolyte Applicant. Am I right?

scripts.speaker: Father Yosuke
scripts.text:
You...
Novice.
There something
you wanna tell me?

scripts.speaker: Father Yosuke
scripts.text: Hey...

scripts.speaker: Father Yosuke
scripts.text:
Do you have anything to say? Because unfortunately for you,
I don't any replies.

scripts.speaker: Father Yosuke
scripts.text: Have you any more business with me?! You don't! Go back to the Sanctuary now!

scripts.speaker: Father Yosuke
scripts.text:
Not bad, not bad. You withstood the penance trial pretty well.
So what's your name?

scripts.speaker: Father Yosuke
scripts.text: Okay. I'll send a message to the Sanctuary that you, {0}, came to visit me.

scripts.speaker: Father Yosuke
scripts.text: Now go back to the Santuary and finish becoming an Acolyte, kid.

scripts.speaker: Father Yosuke
scripts.text: Not bad at all, you've made it all the way here from Prontera. So what's your name, kid?

scripts.speaker: Father Yosuke
scripts.text: {0}, huh? Why isn't your name on my list?

scripts.speaker: Father Yosuke
scripts.text: You probably made a mistake. Go back to the Santuary, and check with the Bishop.

scripts.speaker: Father Yosuke
scripts.text: If you like, come sit here with me and meditate the great truths. God's majesty is truly inspiring...
